label: Interpreting hand grip strength in hospital employees with post-COVID syndrome compared to non-infected controls: a case-control study.
summary: Post-COVID syndrome (PCS) is characterized by a variety of persistent symptoms following SARS-CoV-2 infection, including fatigue among others. Myalgic encephalomyelitis/chronic fatigue syndrome (ME/CFS) is a related neurological disorder primarily characterized by severe fatigue and post-exertional malaise.
